# XCTest

<!-- generated:header (isim/tools/coverage-summary.py; do not edit by hand) -->
**Symbols:** 46.1% of Apple's iOS API (196 of 425, exact) · **Rows:** 11: 5 ✅ 4 🟡 2 ❌ · **iOS:** None+
<!-- /generated:header -->

**Area:** [Developer tools](../COVERAGE.md#devtools) · **Apple:** [XCTest](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/xctest) · **Issues:** [`area:devtools`](https://github.com/kolabs-dev/isim/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3Aarea%3Adevtools)

## How isim implements it

- **Adapted:** an Objective-C framework (`isim/frameworks/XCTest`) with a Swift overlay and isim's own `xctest` runner.
- XCUITest runs the app under test as a second isim process, driven over the control channel.

## API

| API / feature | Status | iOS | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `isim test` (xcodebuild-style test runs) | ✅ | ≤17 | scheme Testables (skipped tests honored), `-only-testing:`/`-skip-testing:`, Xcode console format, `** TEST SUCCEEDED/FAILED **`, exit 65 on failures, `-resultBundlePath DIR` (logs + JUnit/xUnit XML; not an `.xcresult`); hosted tests run inside the app (`TEST_HOST`, bundle in `PlugIns/`), others in isim's `xctest` runner; tested (HelloToolchain, passing and deliberately failing runs) |
| Test plans (`.xctestplan`; `isim test -testPlan`, `-showTestPlans`, `-only-test-configuration` / `-skip-test-configuration`) | ✅ | ≤17 | a scheme's `TestPlans`: `-testPlan NAME`, else the default plan when the scheme has no Testables (before: "has no test targets"); the plan's enabled test targets with their skipped and selected tests, its default options and each configuration's (environment variables, arguments; `language` / `region` become `ISIM_LANGUAGES` / `ISIM_LOCALE`), run once per configuration (result files get the configuration's name). Not applied: code coverage, test repetition, timeouts and the other execution options. Tested (HelloToolchain, its plans scheme: test_test_plans) |
| Unit tests: XCTest (ObjC and Swift) | 🟡 | ≤17 | ObjC-runtime discovery (`test*` methods; Swift `throws`/`async` variants), setUp/tearDown (class, `WithError`, `async`), teardown blocks, assertions (ObjC macros with `@try/@catch` for `XCTAssertThrows*`; Swift functions incl. accuracy, identity, `XCTAssertThrowsError`, `XCTUnwrap`), uncaught NSExceptions and thrown Swift errors recorded, `continueAfterFailure = false` (interruption exception), expectations (`wait(for:)`, `waitForExpectations`, inverted, notification/predicate (unverified), `fulfillment(of:)`, enforced order (unverified)), `XCTWaiter`, `XCTSkip`/`XCTSkipIf`, `measure` (10 runs, average; no baselines), `XCTestObservation` (unverified); tested (HelloToolchain). Missing: `XCTContext.runActivity`, `XCTExpectFailure`, `XCTIssue`, `XCTKeyPathExpectation`; `.xctestplan` schemes are not read |
| Attachments (`XCTAttachment`, `XCTActivity`, `XCTestCase.add(_:)`) | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: `init(data:)`, `init(data:uniformTypeIdentifier:)`, `init(string:)`, `init(contentsOfFile:)`, `init(image:)`, `init(screenshot:)`, `name`, `uniformTypeIdentifier`, `lifetime` (`.keepAlways`, `.deleteOnSuccess`, the default: kept when the test fails), `userInfo`; with `isim test -resultBundlePath DIR` each kept attachment is saved as `DIR/<bundle>.attachments/<Class>/<test>/<name>.<ext>` and named in the console (`Attachment 'NAME' saved: PATH`; not an `.xcresult`); tested (`isim new --tests`: Xcode's launch test attaches its screenshot, test_new_project.py) |
| Performance metrics (`measure(metrics:)`, `measure(options:)`, `XCTMetric`, `XCTClockMetric`, `XCTApplicationLaunchMetric`, `XCTMeasureOptions`, `defaultMetrics`, `defaultMeasureOptions`) | 🟡 | ≤17 | adapted: the block runs `iterationCount` times (default 5) and its wall-clock time is reported per metric in Xcode's console format (`measured [Clock Monotonic Time, s]`, `[Duration (AppLaunch), s]`: the block launches the app, timed until it shows a window with content; `waitUntilResponsive` measures the same); no baselines; `invocationOptions` (manual start/stop), CPU, memory, storage and signpost metrics are not in isim; tested (`isim new --tests`: Xcode's `testLaunchPerformance`, test_new_project.py) |
| UI tests (XCUITest) | 🟡 | ≤17 | `XCUIApplication` launches the TEST_TARGET_NAME app as its own simulator process (launch arguments/environment, terminate, `state` incl. `.runningBackground`, `activate()` back from the background); element queries by type/identifier/label/predicate on accessibility snapshots (`dump FILE`), `exists`, `waitForExistence`, `label`/`value`/`placeholderValue`/`isHittable`/`hasFocus`; `tap`, `typeText` (any text, `;` included: the control channel's `\;`), switches, `swipeUp/Down/Left/Right`, `press(forDuration:)`, `adjust(toNormalizedSliderPosition:)`, `coordinate(withNormalizedOffset:)` + `withOffset` `tap` / `press(forDuration:thenDragTo:)` (a held press, then the drag); the system keyboard as `keyboards` / `keys` (`app.keys["a"]`, `"shift"`, `"delete"`, `"more"`, `"space"`; return is `keyboards.buttons["Return"]`); system permission alerts (notifications, camera/microphone, photos, location, contacts, calendars, paste…) under `XCUIApplication(bundleIdentifier: "com.apple.springboard")`, not the app, and `addUIInterruptionMonitor(withDescription:handler:)` / `removeUIInterruptionMonitor` (adapted: isim draws these alerts in the app process; SpringBoard holds only them, no home-screen icons); `XCUIDevice.orientation` set and read back from the app's `UIDevice.orientation`, `press(.home)` sends the app to the background (no home screen under `isim test`); `.volumeUp/.volumeDown` are ignored (stub: device-only on iOS, like Apple's Simulator); tested (HelloToolchain `AppUITests`: the notification prompt through springboard, the camera prompt through a monitor; `tests/ui/test_toolchain.py::test_scheme`). Missing: pinch, rotate, velocity swipes, `performAccessibilityAudit`, `resetAuthorizationStatus(for:)` |
| Screenshots (`XCUIScreenshot`, `XCUIScreenshotProviding`, `XCUIScreen.main` / `.screens`, `XCUIElement.screenshot()`) | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: the app's process draws its screen (script command `shot`), `image` sized in points (its scale is the screenshot's), `pngRepresentation`; an element's screenshot is its frame of the app's; `XCUIScreen.main` shows the most recently launched or activated app; tested (`isim new --tests`, test_new_project.py) |
| `runsForEachTargetApplicationUIConfiguration` | 🟡 | ≤17 | adapted: a class property tests override (Xcode's launch-test template does); the test runs once, in the device's current configuration, not once per appearance and orientation |
| `XCUIApplication.launch()` from a new instance | ✅ | ≤17 | one process per app, like iOS: a new `XCUIApplication()` refers to the running app, and `launch()` terminates it first, whichever instance launched it (before, each new instance started another copy) |
| Types not yet in isim (iOS 17 and earlier) | ❌ | ≤17 | not implemented, found by the 2026-10 sweep: `XCTActivity`, `XCTApplicationLaunchMetric`, `XCTClockMetric`, `XCTCPUMetric`, `XCTDarwinNotificationExpectation`, `XCTestLog`, `XCTestObserver`, `XCTestProbe`, `XCTExpectedFailure`, `XCTExpectedFailure.Options`, `XCTIssueReference`, `XCTMeasureOptions`, `XCTMemoryMetric`, `XCTMutableIssue`, `XCTOSSignpostMetric`, `XCTPerformanceMeasurement`, `XCTPerformanceMeasurementTimestamp`, `XCTSourceCodeContext`, `XCTSourceCodeFrame`, `XCTSourceCodeLocation`, `XCTSourceCodeSymbolInfo`, `XCTStorageMetric` (22 types; with their members under "Not yet in isim") |
| Types not yet in isim (iOS 26) | ❌ | 26.0 | not implemented, found by the 2026-10 sweep: `XCTHitchMetric` (1 type; with its members under "Not yet in isim") |
